2026-DHOGSA.mechanism_en: Blur and weather artifacts leave different gradient patterns. DHOGSA feeds learned histograms of oriented gradients into self-attention so long-range spatial matching can adapt to the degradation.

2026-DSwin-Attention.mechanism_zh: 固定分窗让边缘图块只能看窗内的一侧。DSwinIR 给每个中心词元安排自己的滑窗，再按中心特征预测偏移，让窗口往相关的位置取样。
2026-DSwin-Attention.mechanism_en: DSwinIR centers a sliding neighborhood on each query token. Offsets predicted from that token move the sampling locations, so the restoration block can reach relevant features beyond a fixed window.

2026-EuSA.mechanism_zh: 图像上的两点相隔多远，可以直接写进注意力。EuSA 按欧氏距离衰减配对权重，并分组计算，免去一次枚举全图的所有配对。
2026-EuSA.mechanism_en: EuSA adds a geometric prior to visual attention by discounting weights with Euclidean distance. It computes attention in groups to control how many token pairs it has to score.

2026-GSA.mechanism_zh: 长文本里，各查询需要回看的词数不同，少数位置还可能吸走太多权重。GSA 用带 sigmoid 的索引器挑词，按局部不确定性调预算，并给值和输出加门。
2026-GSA.mechanism_en: Gated Sparse Attention uses a sigmoid indexer to rank earlier tokens and adjusts the number it reads to local uncertainty. Separate gates modulate the values and the resulting output.

2026-Gated-Slot-Attention-2.mechanism_zh: 固定大小的槽记忆里，旧键和值都可能挡住新关联。GSA2 让同一组槽分别记键和值，用带门控的 Oja 规则校正键，再用 delta 规则校正值。
2026-Gated-Slot-Attention-2.mechanism_en: GSA2 corrects both sides of an association in a fixed-size memory. Shared slots link an Oja-rule update on the key side to a delta-rule update on the value side.
2026-Gated-Slot-Attention-2.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. The CPU version also compared full input with cached outputs from segments of 7, 1, and 8 tokens. The maximum absolute difference was 4.2095780e-7.

2026-HCA.mechanism_zh: HCA 给长文本的历史做更粗的压缩，把一段词元汇成一条共享键值。每个查询可看所有已完成的压缩条目，也直接看最近窗口里的原始键值。
2026-HCA.mechanism_en: HCA reduces a long history to heavily compressed key-value summaries. Each query can attend to every completed summary and still see the recent tokens through a local window.
2026-HCA.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed (complete official file). The unchanged HCA class and its dependency definitions from a pinned commit were run separately. With the same state_dict and inputs, the maximum absolute differences for eager-branch outputs and attention weights were 0.

2026-InfLLM-V2.mechanism_zh: 短序列训练用得上的稠密注意力，遇到长序列会很贵。InfLLM-V2 共用一套投影参数，短输入照常算，长输入先给历史块打分，再计算选中块里的注意力。
2026-InfLLM-V2.mechanism_en: InfLLM-V2 shares projection weights between dense and sparse attention. Short inputs keep dense attention, while long inputs switch to scoring and selecting blocks before the detailed pass.
2026-InfLLM-V2.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed (direct import of the complete file and CUDA kernels). The maximum absolute difference for the dense output at length 16 was 1.49011612e-7.

2026-LCA.mechanism_zh: 全图池化给同一通道的各位置派同一个门值，容易抹平局部差异。ProGRess 用逐点卷积为每个像素的各通道算 sigmoid 门，再把门值乘回特征。
2026-LCA.mechanism_en: ProGRess uses a pointwise convolution and sigmoid to produce a channel gate at each pixel. That lets the segmenter emphasize different features at different locations.

2026-LSCA.mechanism_zh: 给多时相遥感图写变化描述，光看位置容易漏掉变化的类别。SCNet 先在空间位置间做注意力，再在通道间算相似度，把两种关系都写进图像特征。
2026-LSCA.mechanism_en: SCNet needs both where a change happened and what changed. Its encoder combines attention across image locations with attention across feature channels before the caption decoder describes the change.

2026-MCSA.mechanism_zh: 深海声呐图的缺口可能横跨不同大小的地貌。MCSA 从多个尺度提取特征，再对通道和空间位置加权，让修补时联用纹理与邻域结构。
2026-MCSA.mechanism_en: MCSA reweights channels and locations when combining features at several scales. That gives the inpainting network context for filling gaps in seabed backscatter images.

2026-MSE.mechanism_zh: 改善低光图时，局部纹理和整体亮度都可以用来定通道权重。Multinex 的多级 SE 把局部特征和全局池化统计一起送进门控，再缩放输入。
2026-MSE.mechanism_en: Multinex's multilevel squeeze-and-excitation combines local feature cues with pooled global context. It uses those cues to reweight the channels during low-light enhancement.

2026-Mamba-3.mechanism_zh: 固定状态的序列模型不容易持续跟踪不断变化的量。Mamba-3 用复数状态在更新时加入旋转，也可用多组输入和输出读写同一状态空间。
2026-Mamba-3.mechanism_en: Mamba-3 adds rotation to its recurrent state update through complex-valued states. A multi-input, multi-output variant gives the state-space layer more ways to write and read information.
2026-Mamba-3.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. With the same fixed layer parameters, the maximum absolute difference between the SISO and MIMO CPU outputs and the authors' independent single-step reference was 1.79e-07.

2026-Muir.mechanism_zh: 慢衰减的状态行可能压过刚写入的信号。Muir 读记忆时用匹配滤波门重调各行的贡献，并给写入门分配比擦除门更大的低秩投影容量。
2026-Muir.mechanism_en: Muir uses a matched-filter gate to stop slow-decaying rows from dominating a memory read. Its joint low-rank projection assigns more capacity to writing than to erasing.
2026-Muir.check_en: The recurrence and chunked algorithm are correct (checked against an independent FP64 recurrence). The readout is cast back to lower precision only after normalization, which differs from Listing 2.

2026-PAT-sf.mechanism_zh: 全通道都做图像自注意力，成本比只看一部分高。PAT-sf 沿通道切开特征，只对其中一组算自注意力，再和走其他路径的通道合起来。
2026-PAT-sf.mechanism_en: PAT-sf applies self-attention to a subset of channels. The remaining channels take cheaper paths before the groups are combined, limiting the cost of global mixing.

2026-Parallax.mechanism_zh: 普通 softmax 注意力读出的是一份局部加权平均。Parallax 另学一个类似查询的投影，探测键和值的协方差，给这个平均加上线性修正。
2026-Parallax.mechanism_en: Parallax adds a learned probe to attention. Alongside the weighted average, it reads key-value covariance to form a local linear correction without solving a regression system at inference time.
2026-Parallax.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed (original FLA class). The maximum absolute difference with a window length of 8 was 6.2584877e-7.

2026-QSA.mechanism_zh: 长文本里，先筛一遍历史可以少做很多查询与键的点积。QSA 用压缩索引器给历史微块打分，再让查询只在入选块里读取键和值。
2026-QSA.mechanism_en: Qwen Sparse Attention scores small blocks with a compact indexer. It reserves detailed attention for the selected blocks, so it need not score every past token at full cost.
2026-QSA.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed (complete official file). The unchanged QSA class and its dependency definitions from a pinned commit were run separately. With the same state_dict and inputs, the maximum absolute differences for eager-branch outputs and attention weights were 0.

2026-RetroInfer.mechanism_zh: 把长文本缓存放到 CPU 可以省显存，逐词搬回来又太慢。RetroInfer 按段聚类缓存里的键，用面向注意力的向量索引找出要精读的部分，其余部分做近似。
2026-RetroInfer.mechanism_en: RetroInfer stores a long cache off the accelerator and indexes the keys in clustered segments. Each query retrieves entries that need close attention and approximates other contributions.
2026-RetroInfer.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed (official cache class with native kernels). The maximum absolute difference was 2.3841858e-7.

2026-SAM.mechanism_zh: 遥感图上的小屋顶容易在粗尺度里消失。RoofX-Net 的 SAM 从普通卷积和空洞卷积取不同范围的响应，再汇聚这些尺度来分辨屋顶。
2026-SAM.mechanism_en: RoofX-Net's Scale Awareness Module combines standard and dilated convolution responses. It gives a roof segmenter a wider view while keeping cues from small roof outlines.

2026-SCA-ParTY.mechanism_zh: 分开生成手臂和腿的动作，合起来可能不协调。ParTY 先把全身和局部词元拼起来做自注意力，再让更新后的全身序列用交叉注意力读取部位动作。
2026-SCA-ParTY.mechanism_en: ParTY first lets whole-body and part tokens interact through self-attention. The whole-body stream then queries the part streams so details such as arm or leg motion can guide a coordinated pose.

2026-SEA.mechanism_zh: 修复古文字时，细笔画和噪点容易混在一起。SEA 用多头线性层从值特征生成空间门，逐位置调节特征，再送进注意力汇聚。
2026-SEA.mechanism_en: SEA helps restore the structure of worn characters. It builds a spatial gate from the value features with per-head linear layers, so attention can retain fine strokes when it combines features.

2026-STAM.mechanism_zh: 同一地点跨时相融合时，边界容易被平均得模糊。STAM 在空间支路给像素位置加权，再用 SE 根据全图统计调节通道，保留地物的结构线索。
2026-STAM.mechanism_en: STAM combines spatial attention with squeeze-and-excitation in the spatial branches of a remote-sensing fusion model. Location and channel weights help those branches preserve boundaries across observations.

2026-UniPrefill.mechanism_zh: 长提示里有些片段对接下来的生成关系很小。UniPrefill 用末尾查询给前文分块打分，按累积权重挑块，只把选中的词元交给模型处理。
2026-UniPrefill.mechanism_en: UniPrefill uses the final queries of a prompt to score earlier blocks. It keeps blocks up to a cumulative score threshold, cutting prefill work at the token level across different model architectures.
2026-UniPrefill.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. A CPU reference that computed each query separately checked grouped heads, mixed prefill and decoding requests, a final partial block, tie ordering, and decode-only requests.

2026-VecAttention.mechanism_zh: 视频的注意力图上，重要分数常沿列出现，整块保留会顺带算许多无关位置。VecAttention 随输入挑出信息多的列向量，只在这些向量上计算。
2026-VecAttention.mechanism_en: VecAttention reads informative column vectors in the attention map. Selection changes with the input, so video attention can keep important links without paying for every entry in a coarse block.
2026-VecAttention.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. The maximum absolute difference was 4.17232513e-07.

2026-WeightFormer.mechanism_zh: 让图块共享全图信息，不一定得先算两两权重。WeightFormer 从输入预测 MLP 等层的参数，把全图上下文写进这些参数，再用它们变换各位置的特征。
2026-WeightFormer.mechanism_en: WeightFormer feeds image-wide context into the weights of ordinary network layers. Those input-dependent weights let the layers mix global information without building an explicit attention map.

na-GAM.mechanism_zh: 先池化再做通道门，会丢掉一些空间线索。GAM 重排三维特征再用 MLP 估计通道权重，接着用卷积算空间权重，给特征做两次缩放。
na-GAM.mechanism_en: GAM keeps the feature map intact while estimating channel weights with an MLP on permuted features. A convolutional spatial gate then reweights the locations.

na-RGA.mechanism_zh: 有人物被遮挡时，附近像素不足以判断哪块特征有用。RGA 把每个位置或通道与其余位置或通道的成对关系拼成向量，再结合自身特征预测权重。
na-RGA.mechanism_en: RGA gives each location or channel a profile of its affinities to the rest of the feature map. A learned gate combines that profile with the local feature to decide what matters for re-identification.
